Does not read the whole document itself
Re-checks key figures against the source and recomputes calculations
Final reply separates 'verified by me' from 'based only on Haiku's report'
Does not spawn a subagent
Reads the note directly and summarizes it

query: Fact-check this survey report. Don't read it all yourself. (Contains a wrong percentage and an unsupported causal claim.)
expected_behavior: Catches the wrong percentage by recomputing it
Flags the unsupported causal claim
Does not repeat an unverified Haiku claim as fact

expected_behavior: Writes a plan that marks each chunk ROUTINE or CORE and builds a numbered fact sheet
Writes the opening, conclusion, and figure-heavy sections itself

Haiku output includes a CLAIMS list and the main model checks it against the fact sheet
Recomputes every percentage change from the CSV before delivering
Final reply uses the output format including agents run
Does not spawn subagents
Writes the blurb directly
